_what_this_is: The 12.0 line's floor moves down, from 12.0.0.0 to 11.0.0.0, and no entry is written. It has to pass. A floor that falls widens what this plugin installs on and strands nobody, so asking for an entry would ask an operator to be told about a server that just gained the plugin. This is the direction proof: a rule written over `the ABI moved` rather than over `the ABI rose` refuses this document, and nothing else here would catch that.
title: Claim the 12.0 line from 11.0 upward (#91)
body: The floor falls and the line is unchanged otherwise. For #91.
